第八章 不敢承认对她动心(1)
夏羽柔姊弟一连四天的日常都与过去相同，唯一不同的是，他们沉思的时间变多了，而且大多数时候都是瞪着汤绍玄留下的墨宝。
当姊姊的看出弟弟是喜欢汤绍玄的字，对字面上的涵意也是心动的，只是他不开口，显然是纠结，纠结的一定是钱，找老师要花钱，何况还是单独教导。
她也纠结，她手边真的没钱，食堂生意再好，也只是一上午，扣掉食材人事成本，盈余就那么一点点，足够平日开销，没什么积蓄。
但弟弟的愿望，就算再困难，她这当姊姊的也要帮他完成。
于是这一日，算算时间，应该是午憩结束了，夏羽柔便循着记忆里的印象步行到采石场，打算跟汤绍玄谈一谈。
山峦叠嶂，采石场不如儿时记忆的风沙大，但数十个工人在光秃秃的石场敲敲打打，扛着装满石块的担子在石阶上上下下，刺目的阳光下，每个工人都是汗流浃背。
工人们都认识她，知道她来找汤绍玄，表情很多，知情者带笑、带着鼓励，不知情者，带着探究好奇与了然，他们都知道汤绍玄的早膳都是在夏家食堂打发，而夏羽柔是个年轻美丽的女子，看上俊美冷漠的汤绍玄不意外。
夏羽柔没管这些目光，不见吴奕等较熟的那一帮人，她真接问工人，才知是帮忙搬石头去了，另一名也熟识旳刘工头便带着她往另一边林荫下的屋舍群走，两人一路来到一栋大院子前，刘工头道：「汤爷就在里面。」
夏羽柔向他道谢，突然有些紧张，这还是她跟汤绍玄相识这么久，她第一次来到他的办公处。
院子的两扇木门大敞，让人一眼就能看到居中的屋子，而汤绍玄就坐在窗边，正在跟人说话，此时阳光灿烂，他完美精致的侧脸一清二楚的落在她眼里。
屋里在做报告的是采石场西区的管事沈谅。
他是台面上的管事，实则是汤绍玄身后暗卫的头儿。
两人在外人面前，看似在处理讨论采石场的事务，实则是在汇报由京城及其他城池的琢玉坊送过来的所有消息。
夏羽柔自是不知这些，刘工头送她到这里就先走了，她正要往里走，就听到女子哭声，她一愣，顺着声音看过去，就见到屋子左侧凉亭里的一对主仆。
很巧，是熟人。
可能是亭柱的角度问题，她看到她们，她们却没看到她。
忽然，骆玉玫走出凉亭，脸上还有泪痕，一副娇弱动人样。
小翠还在愤愤不平，「汤爷太过分了，小姐亲手熬的汤啊，为熬这汤手都烫伤了，汤爷竟连喝也不喝一口。」
「不许你说汤爷，怪我没有吸引他的厨艺。」

「小姐，你回去要骂大总管的婆娘，说什么要抓住一个男人的心要先抓住他的胃，汤爷根本就是个油盐不进的主儿。」
「不许你这么说汤爷，是我的错，他不是普通的男人，我怎么能用普通的方法来表示我对他的爱。」
小翠一直愤愤说着，骆玉玫虽然嘴上驳斥，可是却一直给她使眼色，目光还见赞许，夏羽柔这才看出来，这对主仆在唱双簧，难怪两人说话都这么大声。
夏羽柔的目光落到坐在窗后的汤绍玄，即使一张俊颜冷冰冰的，但举手投足仍给人一种优雅从容的贵公子气息，也难怪不少姑娘春心萌动，连她都看花了眼。
骆玉玫主仆此时也看到她了，她们能进到采石场是塞了银子的，也听到不少小道消息，知道这个弃妇贿赂不少采石场的工人替她说好话，想要博得汤绍玄的好感。
骆玉玫不禁打量起她，衣着朴素，梳了妇人发髻，可偏偏那张脸白皙娇嫩，一双水翦明眸好似会说话，她身上还有一股俐落爽朗的气质，能让人轻易的放下心防。
不得不说，夏羽柔的确是个有姿色的女子，难怪不少人私下说，青雪镇上三朵花不如夏家食堂的夏娘子。
「夏娘子是来见汤爷的？」骆玉玫口气不好。
「是。」夏羽柔感到敌意扑面而来。
她脸色更难看，「你们什么关系？」
「这似乎与骆小姐无关。」
「那你找他做什么？」骆玉玫咄咄逼人。
「干你什么事？」
「你不说我不让你进去！」
「请问你是汤爷的谁？」夏羽柔觉得可笑。
「我是他未来的媳妇儿！」
蓦地，脚步声陡起，就见本来与汤绍玄在说话的沈谅走出来，看着唇枪舌剑的两人，方正的脸上似笑非笑，「汤爷嫌两位姑娘吵，说是要吵架到别的地方去吵，另外，」他再看向夏羽柔，眼底多了抹兴味，「汤爷说夏娘子若有事找他就进屋子说，不然就快快走人。」
夏羽柔一愣，连忙向他点个头，快步越过他，进屋去了。
骆玉玫也紧跟着，但沈谅一个箭步挡住她的去路，指着另一个方向，「骆姑娘，大门在另一边。」
骆玉玫抬头看着沈谅，本想撒泼，见他神情越发冷戾，她顿时不敢再闹，跺跺脚，带着小翠气呼呼的往大门方向走。

她一边走一边骂，「凭什么？一个下堂妇而已，汤爷为什么要听她说话？」
小翠低着头，亦步亦趋的跟在身后，她不敢说，夏羽柔仅着布衣，素面朝天，与打扮得贵气十足的主子相较却毫不逊色，甚至更胜一分，男人都是爱好美色的，汤绍玄又怎能不对她另眼看待？
另一边，夏羽柔一进到屋里，就见到坐在案桌后方的汤绍玄，他一身靛蓝色长衫，正低头看着桌上的册子。
他抬眸看向她，目光又落在册上，「有事就说。」
夏羽柔已经习惯求人不若求己，此刻要破例，她还真的有些扭捏。
她硬着头皮张了张唇，还是吐不出话来，她咬咬下唇，在心里告诉自己，汤绍玄的学识绝对能够胜任夫子之职，只是，他分明是她为保小命小心讨好的对象，如今要得寸进尺的请他教弟弟功课，会不会被他揍？
但他留下的那幅字，意思应该就是提议由他来教阿晨……
犹豫再三，她还是厚着脸皮开口，「汤爷，我想请你，咳——请你给阿晨指导课业！他基础扎实，肯读又聪明，你可以考校看看！我愿意付学费的，只是不会很多，不知……不知我帮你做的那些衣服鞋袜，能不能抵一些？呃——还没做好，要做得很完美，所以慢工出细活！」说到后来，她又扭捏起来，她从没想到会有这么一天，她得来求这个差点一手掐死她的男人。
汤绍玄也看出她的不自在，倒没刁难，他本就是特意显露才学并留下那幅字的，「我跟阿晨谈谈，看看他本身的意愿。」
夏羽柔眼睛瞬间一亮，「他在家里，我马上找他来。」
她没让他跟着，是怕汤绍玄拒绝，让他难堪。
「不用了，我跟你走一趟。」
「吴伯伯他们说的对，汤爷真是个大好人。」这马屁她是拍得心甘情愿。
汤绍玄见她又一副狗腿状，低头一笑，与她一起离开办公处，派人准备马车。
两个地方的距离不远，马车速度又快，两人很快回到夏家，夏羽柔兴高采烈的拉着他就往弟弟的房里带。
夏羽晨正瞪着那幅字看，一见姊姊拉着汤绍玄进来，先是愣了，但眼睛马上就亮了，「汤爷怎么么来了？」
「让我们单独谈吧。」他看向多余的第三者，赶人的意思很明显。

Chapter 8 I dare not admit that I am attracted to her (1)
The daily routine of Xia Yurou and her brother was the same as before for four consecutive days. The only difference was that they spent more time meditating, and most of the time they stared at the calligraphy treasure left by Tang Shaoxuan.
As a sister, I saw that my brother liked Tang Shaoxuan's words, and he was also moved by the meaning of the words, but he didn't say anything. He was obviously entangled. The issue must be money. It costs money to find a teacher, not to mention teaching alone.
She was also troubled. She really didn't have any money at hand. No matter how good the canteen business was, it only lasted for one morning. After deducting the cost of food and personnel, the surplus was only a little, enough for daily expenses, and she had no savings.
But no matter how difficult her brother's wish was, she, as a sister, would help him fulfill it.
So on this day, after calculating the time, it seemed that the lunch break was over. Xia Yurou followed the impression in her memory and walked to the quarry, intending to have a talk with Tang Shaoxuan.
There are mountains and mountains, and the quarry is not as big as the wind and sand in childhood memories, but dozens of workers are knocking on the bare stone quarry, carrying burdens full of stones up and down the stone steps, and under the dazzling sunshine, every worker is sweating profusely.
The workers all knew her and knew that she came to Tang Shaoxuan with many expressions. Those who knew were smiling and encouraging, while those who didn't knew were curious and understanding. They all knew that Tang Shaoxuan's breakfast was served in the Xia family cafeteria, and that Xia Yurou was a young and beautiful woman. It was not surprising that she fell in love with the handsome and indifferent Tang Shaoxuan.
Xia Yurou ignored these glances and did not see the familiar group such as Wu Yi. She actually asked the workers and found out that they were helping to move stones. Another foreman Liu, whom she was also familiar with, took her to the group of houses under the trees on the other side. The two of them came to a large courtyard together. Foreman Liu said: "Master Tang is inside."
Xia Yurou thanked him and suddenly became a little nervous. This was the first time she had come to Tang Shaoxuan's office since she had known him for so long.
The two wooden doors of the yard were wide open, allowing people to see the central room at a glance, and Tang Shaoxuan was sitting by the window, talking to someone. The sun was shining brightly, and his perfect and delicate profile fell clearly into her eyes.
The person giving a report in the room was Shen Liang, the manager of the west area of ​​the quarry.
He is the manager on the stage, but in fact he is the leader of the secret guard behind Tang Shaoxuan.
In front of outsiders, the two seemed to be discussing the affairs of the quarry, but in fact they were reporting all the news sent from Zhuoyufang in the capital and other cities.
Xia Yurou didn't know this. Foreman Liu sent her here and left first. Just as she was about to walk in, she heard a woman crying. She was startled, followed the sound and saw a pair of master and servant in the pavilion on the left side of the house.
Coincidentally, they are acquaintances.
Maybe it was the angle of the pavilion pillars. She saw them, but they didn't see her.
Suddenly, Luo Yumei walked out of the pavilion, with tears on her face, looking delicate and touching.
Xiao Cui was still aggrieved, "Master Tang went too far. The lady made the soup with her own hands. My hands were burned trying to make the soup. Master Tang didn't even take a sip."
"You are not allowed to say that Mr. Tang blames me for not attracting his cooking skills."
"Miss, you are going to scold the chief steward's wife when you go back, saying that in order to capture a man's heart, you must first capture his stomach. Mr. Tang is simply a master who doesn't get into things."
"You are not allowed to say that to Mr. Tang. It is my fault. He is not an ordinary man. How can I express my love for him in ordinary ways."
Xiao Cui kept talking angrily. Although Luo Yumei refuted her words, she kept giving her winks and approval. Only then did Xia Yurou realize that the master and servant were singing a double act. No wonder they were talking so loudly.
Xia Yurou's eyes fell on Tang Shaoxuan, who was sitting behind the window. Even though he had a cold handsome face, his movements still gave off the air of an elegant and calm nobleman. It's no wonder that many girls were in love with him, and even she was dazzled by it.
Luo Yumei's master and servant also saw her at this time. They could enterI went to the quarry with money, and I also heard a lot of gossip. I knew that this abandoned woman bribed many quarry workers to say good things for her, hoping to win Tang Shaoxuan's favor.
Luo Yumei couldn't help but look at her. She was dressed in simple clothes and had her hair in a woman's bun, but her face was fair and delicate, with a pair of bright eyes that seemed to be able to speak. She also had a neat and cheerful temperament that made people easily let down their guard.
I have to say that Xia Yurou is indeed a beautiful woman. No wonder many people say privately that the three flowers in Qingxue Town are not as good as Lady Xia in the Xia Family Canteen.
"Ms. Xia is here to see Mr. Tang?" Luo Yumei said in a bad tone.
"Yes." Xia Yurou felt hostility coming towards her face.
Her face turned even more ugly, "What's your relationship?"
"This seems to have nothing to do with Miss Luo."
"Then what are you doing with him?" Luo Yumei was aggressive.
"What are you doing?"
"I won't let you in until you tell me!"
"Who are you from Mr. Tang?" Xia Yurou found it ridiculous.
"I am his future wife!"
Suddenly, the sound of footsteps suddenly picked up, and Shen Liang, who was talking to Tang Shaoxuan, came out. Looking at the two people who were quarreling with each other, his square face seemed to be smiling, "Master Tang thought the two girls were arguing, and said they wanted to quarrel somewhere else. Besides," he looked at Xia Yurou again, with more interest in his eyes, "Master Tang said that if Mrs. Xia has anything to say to him, she should come into the house and talk to him, otherwise she would leave quickly."
Xia Yurou was stunned, nodded to him quickly, walked past him quickly and entered the house.
Luo Yumei followed closely, but Shen Liang blocked her way with an arrow and pointed in another direction, "Miss Luo, the gate is on the other side."
Luo Yumei raised her head and looked at Shen Liang. She wanted to be playful, but when she saw that his expression was getting colder and colder, she immediately did not dare to make any more trouble. She stamped her feet and walked angrily towards the door with Xiao Cui.
She scolded her as she walked away, "Why? She's just a concubine. Why should Mr. Tang listen to her?"
Xiaocui lowered her head and followed step by step. She didn't dare to say that Xia Yurou was only wearing commoner clothes and had no face. Compared with her master who was dressed up in a noble manner, she was no less than, or even better than, her master. Men all love beauty, so how could Tang Shaoxuan not treat her differently?
On the other side, as soon as Xia Yurou entered the room, she saw Tang Shaoxuan sitting behind the desk. He was wearing an indigo blue gown and was looking down at the booklet on the table.
He raised his eyes to look at her, then his eyes fell on the book again, "If you have anything to say, just tell me."
Xia Yurou was used to asking for help from others rather than asking for herself, so she was really a little embarrassed to make an exception now.
She bit her lower lip and told herself in her heart that Tang Shaoxuan's knowledge was definitely qualified for the position of a master. However, he was clearly someone she was careful to please in order to save her life. Now if she went to such extreme lengths to ask him to teach her younger brother homework, would she be beaten by him?
But the words he left behind probably meant that he proposed to teach Ah Chen...
After much hesitation, she still spoke shamelessly, "Master Tang, I want to ask you, uh-please help Ah Chen with his homework! He has a solid foundation, is willing to read, and is smart. You can take the exam and see! I am willing to pay for tuition, but not a lot, I don't know... I don't know if I can help you." Can the clothes, shoes and socks you made be worth a little? Uh--they're not done yet. They have to be perfected, so work slowly and carefully!" When she said it later, she became embarrassed again. She never thought that there would be a day when she would have to beg the man who almost strangled her to death.
Tang Shao
Xia Yurou's eyes lit up instantly, "He is at home, I will find him right away."
She didn't let him follow because she was afraid that Tang Shaoxuan would refuse and embarrass him.
"No, I'll go with you."
"Uncle Wu and the others are right, Mr. Tang is such a good man." She was very fond of flattering him.willingly.
Tang Shaoxuan saw her dog-legged posture again, lowered his head and smiled, left the office with her, and sent someone to prepare the carriage.
The distance between the two places was not far, and the carriage was very fast. The two of them quickly returned to Xia's house. Xia Yurou happily took him to her brother's room.
Xia Yuchen was staring at the words. When she saw her sister dragging Tang Shaoxuan in, she was stunned at first, but her eyes immediately brightened, "Why is Mr. Tang here?"
"Let's talk alone." He looked at the unnecessary third person, his intention to drive them away was obvious.
